title: Master Chef Bistro
description: Step behind the counter of a bustling neighborhood eatery—prep fresh dishes, keep every customer smiling, and grow into a Michelin-level chef.
controls: Tap ingredients and cooking stations to prepare and deliver each customer's requested dish.
